summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase A (E10): Service Types Master & Vehicle Service History. All backend APIs (44/44 tests) and frontend UI flows passed successfully. Features tested: Service Types CRUD with RBAC, custom service types in maintenance form, vehicle service history drawer with stats and records.
passed_tests: Backend: Authentication for owner, ops_admin, driver (3/3)
Backend: GET /api/service-types returns seeded types (Ganti Ban, Ganti Oli, Spooring & Balancing)
Backend: POST /api/service-types creates custom service type with correct ID prefix (svt_)
Backend: POST duplicate service type returns 400 with error message
Backend: POST builtin name collision (e.g., 'Servis') returns 400
Backend: PATCH /api/service-types/{id} updates intervals correctly
Backend: POST /api/maintenance accepts custom service type keys
Backend: GET /api/vehicles/{id}/maintenance returns totals (count, total_cost, done, next_service_date, last_service_date) and records array
Backend: DELETE /api/service-types/{id} removes service type
Backend: Driver role gets 403 on POST/PATCH/DELETE service types (RBAC enforced)
Backend: Driver role gets 200 on GET service types and vehicle maintenance (read access)
Frontend: Login as owner@demo.local successful
Frontend: Navigate to /app/maintenance -> Jenis Service tab
Frontend: Service types table displays seeded types (Ganti Ban, Ganti Oli, Spooring & Balancing)
Frontend: 'Tambah Jenis Service' button opens form dialog
Frontend: Create new service type 'Test Ganti Filter Udara' with intervals (15000 km, 180 days)
Frontend: New service type appears in table after creation
Frontend: Edit service type dialog opens and updates interval
Frontend: Duplicate name validation shows error toast
Frontend: Maintenance form 'Jenis' dropdown includes builtin types (Servis Berkala, Perbaikan, KIR, Pajak, Lainnya)
Frontend: Maintenance form 'Jenis' dropdown includes custom types (Ganti Ban, Ganti Oli, Spooring & Balancing)
Frontend: Vehicle detail drawer opens on vehicle row click
Frontend: 'Riwayat Service' tab displays 4 stat cards (Total Catatan, Selesai, Total Biaya, Servis Berikutnya)
Frontend: Service records table displays maintenance records
Frontend: Tab switching between 'Riwayat Trip' and 'Riwayat Service' works correctly
Frontend: Driver login successful
Frontend: Driver can view service types table (read access)
Frontend: Driver does NOT see 'Tambah Jenis Service' button (RBAC enforced)
Frontend: Driver does NOT see edit/delete action buttons (RBAC enforced)
